name: Absorption prepares one empty official Free Cities Temple for original work custody

condition.code:
local state=assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_Absorption).GetState()
local tx=state.Transactions['native-product-return-probe']
if not tx or tx.Status~='COMPLETE' then return false end
for _,work in ipairs(tx.NativeWorks or {}) do
 if work.Custodian then
  local slot=work.TargetSlot
  local p=Players[slot.Owner]
  local city=p and p:GetCities():FindID(slot.City)
  if not city or city:GetX()~=slot.X or city:GetY()~=slot.Y
    or city:GetBuildings():GetGreatWorkInSlot(slot.Building,slot.Slot)~=work.Source.Index then return false end
 end
end
return true

steps.code:
local owner,id,x,y,building=10,327684,114,45,12
local city=assert(Players[owner]:GetCities():FindID(id),'official carrier city not published')
assert(city:GetX()==x and city:GetY()==y,'official carrier city position changed')
local buildings=city:GetBuildings()
assert(buildings:HasBuilding(building) and not buildings:IsPillaged(building),'official carrier Temple unavailable')
assert(buildings:GetNumGreatWorkSlots(building)==1 and buildings:GetGreatWorkInSlot(building,0)==-1,'official carrier Temple slot not empty')
local slotType=assert(GameInfo.GreatWorkSlotTypes[buildings:GetGreatWorkSlotType(building,0)]).GreatWorkSlotType
assert(slotType=='GREATWORKSLOT_RELIC','carrier is not an official relic slot')
for def in GameInfo.Buildings() do
 if buildings:HasBuilding(def.Index) then
  for slot=0,buildings:GetNumGreatWorkSlots(def.Index)-1 do
   assert(buildings:GetGreatWorkInSlot(def.Index,slot)==-1,'carrier city contains another official work')
  end
 end
end
local state=assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_Absorption).GetState()
local tx=assert(state.Transactions['native-product-return-probe'])
assert(tx.Status=='COMPLETE','prior absorption not complete')
ExposedMembers.JAC_FreeCarrierPlan={Owner=owner,ID=id,X=x,Y=y,Building=building,Slot=0,SlotType=slotType}
return 'empty official Temple carrier observed without other works'

local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay)
local observed=assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_FreeCarrierPlan,'UI carrier observation absent')
local city=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(observed.X,observed.Y))
assert(city:GetOwner()==observed.Owner and city:GetID()==observed.ID,'carrier identity changed')
assert(Players[observed.Owner]:GetCities():GetCount()>=2,'carrier would eliminate its owner')
local occupied={}
for _,work in ipairs(A.OwnedGreatWorkSlots(observed.Owner)) do
 if work.X==observed.X and work.Y==observed.Y then occupied[#occupied+1]=work.Index end
end
assert(#occupied==0,'carrier holds an untracked official work')
local free=assert(PlayerManager.GetFreeCitiesPlayerID())
assert(Players[free] and Players[free]:GetCities():GetCount()==0,'Free Cities carrier already exists')
local plan=A.Rules.Copy(observed)
plan.Free=free
Game:SetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_FREE_CARRIER',plan)
CityManager.TransferCity(city,free)
return 'empty official Temple city transfer requested for Free Cities custody'

condition.code:
local plan=Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_FREE_CARRIER')
local city=plan and CityManager.GetCityAt(plan.X,plan.Y)
if not city or city:GetOwner()~=plan.Free then return false end
local b=city:GetBuildings()
return b:HasBuilding(plan.Building) and b:GetNumGreatWorkSlots(plan.Building)==1
  and b:GetGreatWorkInSlot(plan.Building,plan.Slot)==-1

steps.code:
local plan=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_FREE_CARRIER'))
local city=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(plan.X,plan.Y))
assert(city:GetOwner()==plan.Free,'carrier was not published as Free Cities')
local b=city:GetBuildings()
assert(b:HasBuilding(plan.Building) and not b:IsPillaged(plan.Building)
  and b:GetNumGreatWorkSlots(plan.Building)==1
  and b:GetGreatWorkInSlot(plan.Building,plan.Slot)==-1,'official carrier slot changed')
ExposedMembers.JAC_FreeCarrierPublished={Owner=plan.Free,ID=city:GetID(),X=city:GetX(),Y=city:GetY(),Building=plan.Building,Slot=plan.Slot}
return 'Free Cities owns the same empty official Temple slot'

local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay)
local plan=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_FREE_CARRIER'))
local published=assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_FreeCarrierPublished)
local city=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(plan.X,plan.Y))
assert(city:GetOwner()==plan.Free and city:GetID()==published.ID
  and city:GetX()==published.X and city:GetY()==published.Y,'Free Cities carrier identity changed')
assert(#A.OwnedGreatWorkSlots(plan.Free)==0,'Free Cities carrier unexpectedly holds a work')
local returned=A.NativeWorkLocations(2)
assert(#returned==1 and returned[1].Owner==2 and returned[1].CityID==196610
  and returned[1].X==147 and returned[1].Y==41 and returned[1].Building==1 and returned[1].Slot==0,'original returned work changed during carrier setup')
local reads=assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_HeroReadAPI)
local freeSlots=reads.FindCompatibleNativeSlots(plan.Free,returned[1].ObjectType)
local humanSlots=reads.FindCompatibleNativeSlots(1,returned[1].ObjectType)
assert(#freeSlots==1 and freeSlots[1].Owner==plan.Free and freeSlots[1].City==city:GetID()
  and freeSlots[1].X==plan.X and freeSlots[1].Y==plan.Y
  and freeSlots[1].Building==plan.Building and freeSlots[1].Slot==plan.Slot,'Free Cities compatible slot was not unique and exact')
assert(#humanSlots==1 and humanSlots[1].Owner==1 and humanSlots[1].City==196610
  and humanSlots[1].X==129 and humanSlots[1].Y==35
  and humanSlots[1].Building==12 and humanSlots[1].Slot==0,'human recovery Temple slot changed')
plan.ID=city:GetID()
plan.Recovery=humanSlots[1]
plan.WorkIndex=returned[1].Index
plan.Work=returned[1]
Game:SetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_FREE_CARRIER',plan)
print('[JAC_NATIVE_FREE_CARRIER_READY] '..A.Canonical(plan))
return 'Free Cities carrier and human recovery slot exact; original work still unique at AI2'
